Procedure:Minor maintenance Procedures (P1-Y2)
Introduction
This document outlines the 
minor maintenance procedures 
P1, 
which must be performed 
every two years 
as 
indicated by Y2 in the above title block.
The 
soot blower used for cleaning superheater, reheater, economizer tubes, and 
regenerative air heater baskets.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil 
at edec, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection and quality 
control head sector
Technical Specification
Soot blower type
1.
 Retractable
2. Semi-Retractable
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses,... 
 etc
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker for the motor of this soot blower
Isolate the 
 electrical cable feeding of the motor of this 
 soot blower
The soot blower 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valve
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, manual puller,
Suitable lifting device, feeler gauge
Hammer,
 and air wrench.
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Remove four cap screws from the top cover.
Remove four cap screws from the top cover.
Remove the top cover assembly.
Remove rollers and drive pinions to check 
 for wear or cracks change if needed.
Remove the retaining ring, oil seal and change 
 them, and 
 check bearing and housing 
 is OK or not.
Remove the packing and the solid gland and change them.
Remove the poppet valve to check all inside components and turn on.
Remove the lance and tubes of steam and air, check for cracks
Remove carriage rollers check for wear, change if needed
Check and grease the chain if necessary at figure 1
Support the carriage by means of a hoist through the access hole in the top of 
 the beam Remove the two short carriage support angles at the rear of the beam 
 and lower the carriage
Carriage Reassembly
The carriage 
should be reassembled in the reverse order of disassembly. This order of 
assembly will eliminate interference problems 
with each previously assembled group of parts 
see figure 1.
